'''''Star Wars Adventures''''' is an ongoing anthology ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series. The series was originally solicited to begin on [[May 20]], [[2020]],<ref name="Comiclist">{{WebCite|url=http://www.comiclist.com/index.php/news/idw-publishing-may-2020-solicitations|text=IDW Publishing May 2020 Solicitations|work=Comiclist|archivedate=20200612055902}}</ref> but due to the [[Wikipedia:Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] [[Wikipedia:2019–20 coronavirus pandemic|pandemic]], [[IDW Publishing]] ceased publication of comics for May 2020.<ref name="CBR">{{WebCite|url=https://www.cbr.com/idw-publishing-suspends-comics-diamond-distributors-coronavirus-covid19|text=IDW Suspends May Releases, Reduces Publishing Line Due to Diamond Hiatus|work=CBR|archivedate=20200324150614}}</ref> The series eventually began with the release of the [[Star Wars Adventures (2020) 1|first issue]] on [[October 7]], 2020<ref name="Issue 1" /> and ended in its [[Star Wars Adventures (2020) 14|final issue]] almost a year and a half later on [[February 9]], [[2022]].<ref name="Issue 14" />
